Path: business reporting | dashboards.chart-type-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade — `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `@object-ui/types` `ObjectChartSchema` (TS and zod faces) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the `object-chart` sibling of objectui#7690, whose ruling (`5809510046`, measure-then-branch, maintainer 「同意」) already answers it: a real producer writes the key (the objectstack showcase command-center page's `yAxis: [{ field, stepSize }]`), so the branch is DECLARE. A new branch reuses the parent ruling ⇒ queued, not escalated; p3 as the parent.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T08:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`. Dedupe by this seat over 725 objectui cards (open, plus closed since 2026-09-18): `ObjectChartSchema` → 4 hits (this card; #8885, open, three OTHER undeclared keys in the same files; #5927, the mirror-drift program; #9549, closed).

Execution note: mirror PR objectui#10511 — the spec's `ChartAxisSchema` by reference, the same boundary ledgers, `Clause-②: yes`. **Same files as #8885** (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts` / `zod/objectql.zod.ts`): serial, or one claim.

Claim: PM loop round 5 — `domain:ui` execution seat 2
Session: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`
Branch: `claude/issue-10518-object-chart-axis-config`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-10518`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface: the `ObjectChartSchema` `xAxis` / `yAxis` declaration on both faces, `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`; the boundary ledgers PR objectui#10511 used (`imported-defaults-8317`, `zod-mirror-parity`); tests beside them; the doc rows that teach `object-chart` axes (`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` only after PR objectui#10571 is on main); pending changesets this change falsifies (the objectui#10533 form); and one `.changeset/10518-…md` (`'@object-ui/types': minor`). Amended by the seat after the dev's `needs_decision`, with option A (seat decision on this card): one typed fixture line in `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.absentCategoryAxisRefusal-8168.test.tsx` (the bare-string `xAxis` leg takes the file's unauthorable-value cast). Stop on breach and explain it in the report
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — `dispatch-gates --tier`: 「no path-derived mandate … floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable」; executes triage `5829725284`, reusing the parent ruling `5809510046` (measure-then-branch; branch 2 DECLARE, because a real producer writes the key), as PR objectui#10511 did on `ChartSchema`
Clause-②: yes
Thread-read: 5829725284
Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T09:59Z. On `objectql.ts`: only the stale draft objectui#8941 (`os-zhuang`, last updated 2026-09-20), whose one-line JSDoc edit at `BulkActionDef.icon` (~:518) is about 3,600 lines from `ObjectChartSchema`. No open PR touches `objectql.zod.ts`. This seat's PR objectui#10573 (objectui#8885 Part 2) edits only `plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`, and the triage note "same files as #8885" referred to Part 1, which landed in PR objectui#8895. PR objectui#10571 (merge queue) edits `plugin-charts.mdx`, and this claim touches that page only after it lands. The one other live claim naming `objectql` is this seat's parked objectui#5157 (`needs_decision`, no branch work). `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

`Clause-②: yes` — `ObjectChartSchema`'s accept set changes: an undeclared passthrough becomes a declared, strict axis config, so a value the spec refuses stops passing the mirror.

## Seat decision on the `needs_decision` above: option A. `ObjectChartSchema.xAxis` is the spec's axis OBJECT only, and a bare string is refused by name with the remedy `xAxis: { field }`. Not a new ruling; the parent ruling's own letter decides it.

`domain:ui` seat #2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`. This answers the dev report on this card (draft PR objectui#10601, "Part of #10518").

- **The parent ruling** (`5809510046`, reused by triage `5829725284`): "declare exactly the keys the renderer reads, **strictly**, … following the spec's `ChartAxisSchema`".
- **Read by the seat on objectstack `origin/main`.** The spec's carrier for this node is `REACT_BLOCKS`' `ObjectChart` entry (`schemaType: 'object-chart'`, `schema: ChartConfigSchema`), and `ChartConfigSchema.xAxis` is `ChartAxisSchema.optional()`, an object with no string arm. So the strict, spec-following declaration is the object only.
- **Why B and C are out.**
  - PR objectui#10511's string arm on `ChartSchema.xAxis` comes from objectui#7113's maintainer ruling (the report-surface alias, folded onto `xAxisKey`), which is scoped to `ChartSchema`. B extends an alias to a second carrier without its own ruling.
  - C mints a second, unfolded spelling beside `xAxisKey`.
  - The measured business need is zero: no producer writes a bare-string `xAxis` on `object-chart` across objectui, objectstack or hotcrm. The producers on this node write `{ field }`.
  - Startup-stage retirement is immediate; there is no tolerance window.
- **What A costs, granted as a surface extension.** One typed fixture line in `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.absentCategoryAxisRefusal-8168.test.tsx`, whose "a bare string `xAxis`, the report surface spelling" leg pins the RENDERER's tolerance (`normalizeChartSchema` still folds a string, and that is not changed here). It takes that file's own unauthorable-value cast idiom, so the leg keeps pinning the renderer while the type stops admitting the shape.

**Patch round on the same claim and PR:**
- add `xAxis` (`ChartAxisSchema` by reference, both faces, with a named list/string remedy in the style of the `yAxis` one);
- pins red on base;
- the fixture cast;
- the changeset extended;
- the PR's first line becomes `Fixes #10518`.

`Clause-②: yes` stands.

**Filed with this decision's round, as a separate card:** the dev's class-b finding. `ObjectChartSchema.xAxisField` / `yAxisFields` / `aggregation` are declared on the node, yet `ObjectChart` reads none of them; they are the list-view chart vocabulary, translated before the node is composed. That goes to ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove under its own ruling.
